_readme: S730 subject-title hunt (group html_c), 2026-11-25, under Sam's ask in session S730: the catalog's printed heading for each course subject code, for the local subject titles that decide each code's common subject (ruling r-no-mid-on-a-stray-code-sam-2026-11-25). Round 1: the Coursedog courses page, with the data its scripts fetch from app.coursedog.com (the vendor, as hartnell_course_units.json names it), to find where the catalog lists its subjects and their names. No model call.

outside_hosts.app.coursedog.com: Hartnell's catalog vendor: the catalog's own scripts call it (hartnell_course_units.json).

questions.subjects: Each subject the catalog's course index lists, with its printed title and code.
questions.index_address: Where the catalog lists its course subjects, if the guessed address is wrong.
